evidence: Bounds the low-byte index to 0..5, loads the nested record pointer at input+0x48, adds 0x32 to the index, and tail-calls attribute_record_value_set. That setter maps IDs 0x18..0x37 to record offset ID+0x10, so this writes byte offsets 0x42..0x47. Callers invoke it as an indexed record setter. decompiled/main/main_0170.c:19528-19542; callers decompiled/main/main_0052.c:27519-27526.

Returns -2 when the input/provider gate fails. Otherwise it obtains nested attribute 0x54 as a float (using the input's provider pointer or the fallback path) and tail-calls a helper that compares that float against fixed thresholds and returns a small integer code. Callers use the result within attribute-context calculations. decompiled/main/main_0112.c:29544-29568; mapper decompiled/main/main_0112.c:29569-29801; caller decompiled/main/main_0112.c:3259-3260.

Queries attribute-context selector 4, rotates the returned 32-bit value right by 31, clears the low bit, subtracts one, and stores the resulting 32-bit value at input+0x24. Its caller invokes the routine while preparing a context record. decompiled/main/main_0090.c:36497-36513; caller decompiled/main/main_0105.c:22684-22685.

Queries context selector 0x13 and returns false unless its low byte equals 3. On that path it calls a helper that scans indices 0..0x98 and increments a count for successful lookups whose returned entry byte at +0x4a is 1..3; this function returns whether that count is nonzero. Callers consume the result as a boolean predicate. decompiled/main/main_0063.c:6064-6087; counted scan decompiled/main/main_0049.c:38286-38324; caller decompiled/main/main_0086.c:12048-12050.

Reads a nested 32-bit value through an object pointer, passes it and a global object at 0x7004650998 through a runtime-dispatched helper, then feeds the returned integer to a float conversion that divides by 100. The caller uses it inside a larger value calculation, but the role of the dispatch and resulting value is unresolved, so leave unnamed. decompiled/main/main_0025.c:33986-34002; caller decompiled/main/main_0007.c:51290-51291.
